name: The Cure for Madness
source:
The Cure for Madness is a game set in a modern Lovecraft universe. Alice Moore, a student of the famous Arkham University, is searching for a way to reverse her brother's deteriorating mental condition. She and some fellow students travel to fictional Virginia City. However, things are not how they seem to be and the city will soon plunge into madness and terror, as the boundaries between her dreams and reality start to crumble. Will she be able to save her brother, her friends, the city... or herself? It's up to you...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/grumpygranny]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《疯狂的治愈》是一款以现代洛夫克拉夫特宇宙为背景的游戏。著名阿卡姆大学的学生爱丽丝摩尔正在寻找一种方法来扭转她哥哥日益恶化的精神状况。她和一些同学前往虚构的弗吉尼亚市。然而，事情并不像看上去的那样，随着她的梦想与现实之间的界限开始崩溃，这座城市很快就会陷入疯狂和恐怖。她能拯救她的兄弟、她的朋友、这座城市……还是她自己？这取决于你…

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/grumpygranny]Patreon[/url]]
